# unzip

List, verify and extract stored or deflated ZIP entries.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/unzip -Z1 bundle.zip
moonx cli/unzip -p bundle.zip notes.txt
moonx cli/unzip -qn -d unpacked bundle.zip
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-Z1` | List archive member names. |
| `-p` | Write selected file contents to stdout. |
| `-t` | Verify entry data and checksums. |
| `-q` | Suppress extraction progress. |
| `-n` | Skip existing output files. |
| `-d VALUE` | Choose the extraction directory. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Selection uses exact member names. Extraction creates regular files and directories under an existing parent and refuses links or existing output files, except that -n skips existing files. Validation precedes extraction. The destination tree must remain under the caller’s control while unpacking. Files created before a filesystem error remain on disk. The in-memory archive and total payload limit is 64 MiB, with up to 65,535 members.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
